company.name: Gleam
company.shortDescription: Mobile fashion discovery and intelligence platform that brings engagement between style lovers and the industry to the next level.
company.description:
Acquired by Farfetch

Bringing users the latest trends in world fashion, Gleam is the perfect platform for discovering, shopping for and organising all things style related in the mobile digital world. By combining this dedicated fashion focused distribution and interaction channel with an analytics offering for brands, Gleam is the perfect way for the industry to keep up with consumers and know in real time how preferences are changing across markets, segments and with fashionistas everywhere.

www.gleamworld.com
www.gleamfashionintelligence.com
